item.description: A North Webster man was recently arrested for allegedly raping and engaging in sexual conduct with a person under the age of 18.

item.title: How Indiana’s new utility law could change your electricity bill
item.description: Governor Mike Braun signed a dense piece of energy legislation, flush with bipartisan support, into law on Thursday, Feb. 26, that aims to address the state’s energy affordability crisis.

item.title: Regulators Call In ‘Big Five’ Energy Providers For Affordability Investigation
item.description: In response to growing customer outrage over high energy bills, the Indiana Utility Regulatory Commission announced Wednesday, Feb. 25 that it will conduct an investigation into affordability for the state’s “big five” investor-owned utility companies next month.

item.title: Mike Jones Named Finalist for Indiana Golden Owl Award
item.description: Mike Jones of Tippecanoe Valley High School has been named a finalist for the Indiana Golden Owl Award.

item.title: Indiana’s Mac And Cheese Festival Heading To South Bend
item.description: Four Winds Field, the iconic home of the South Bend Cubs, will serve as the backdrop for Indiana’s Mac & Cheese Festival this summer. Created by Outlier Events - the national team behind viral hits like Pickle Palooza and the Donut and Beer Fest - the festival is bringing its record-breaking tour to South Bend on Saturday, May 23, 2026.

item.title: Stone’s trace tavern spring hearthside dinner
item.description: The historic Stone’s Trace Tavern will host an authentic 19th-century dinner at 6 p.m. Saturday, April 25.

item.title: Elkhart Announces Year Of Celebration Commemorating Rail Service
item.description: A yearlong celebration marking 175 years of rail service in Elkhart will culminate Oct. 3, 2026, with a daylong anniversary event at the National New York Central Railroad Museum.

item.title: Bristol Opera House Launches Fundraiser To Replace Awning
item.description: The historic Bristol Opera House will remove its longtime front awning next month to accommodate planned roadwork along SR 120, launching a fundraising campaign to replace the more than century-old feature and complete additional exterior repairs.
